style.backgroundSystem: seamless #FFFFFF packshot sweep for product-only screens; solid #3E6CB5 and #2C4E8A brand panels for infographic screens; soft #EEF1F5 to #E4E7EB vertical gradients for grid and spec screens; light #D7E3EE room tones for lifestyle scenes
style.direction: clean-air home appliance ecommerce, cool tech base with one warm accent
style.iconSystem: consistent thin-line circular icons at 1.5px stroke, single warm accent #E8834F on brand panels, plus thin leader lines and small numbered circles, no filled, 3D or skeuomorphic icons
style.lightingSystem: soft diffused studio lighting with a front-left key at 5500K, gentle fill, soft contact shadows and one controlled edge highlight running down the product shell; night scene drops to a low warm 3000K ambient with a soft glow band and a light pool on the surface
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent clean-air home appliance e-commerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of #FFFFFF packshot sweep, #EEF1F5 light mist base, #3E6CB5 brand panel, #2C4E8A deep brand panel, charcoal text #22303F and one warm accent #E8834F; cool tone with a single warm accent; soft diffused studio lighting with a front-left key at 5500K, gentle fill, soft contact shadows and one controlled edge highlight along the product shell; one modern geometric sans-serif for headline and label typesetting only; consistent rounded info labels, thin leader lines and small numbered circles; consistent thin-line icon style at 1.5px stroke; clean high-end appliance photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; product always upright and stable in scale with a grounding contact shadow, every screen composed as one complete balanced layout; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no product redesign.
noDrift: no product redesign or proportion change
style.presentationRules: the tall upright product stays upright, centered or on a stable third, at a repeatable scale across the set; hero angles are a slight 3/4 front or a straight-on front; never tilted, never rotated, never cropped by the frame edge; a soft contact shadow always grounds the base
style.surfaceSystem: matte #FFFFFF lacquer tabletop, light grey #E9EDF2 matte board, warm sand #E9DCCB side table and #D9E2EC floor tile, all read as matte with a soft grounded contact shadow
style.typography: one modern geometric sans-serif for headline and label typesetting only, headline 28-48pt in #22303F or #FFFFFF, labels 10-14pt, numeric spec figures oversized and light-weight, no serif, handwritten or display faces
